Heart Smart Inc. (Clinical Remote Monitoring)
If you mean
Heart Smart Inc.
, they do distribute and utilize clinical-grade, wearable cardiac technology.
UbiqVue™ ECG Patch:
A single-use, disposable, two-channel wearable ECG patch designed for continuous ambulatory cardiac monitoring.
Telemedicine Equipment:
They provide wireless remote monitoring devices and distribute Holter monitoring hardware and analysis software to clinical practices.
